builds.name: Reference: Range and poke
builds.goal: Reference for Vel'Koz: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A geometric artillery mage who combines spell hits to trigger true damage, then channels a beam from a protected angle. Track research stacks and R true-damage eligibility. Magic penetration does not multiply true damage; a full beam needs protection and uninterrupted channel time. Range-compatible spell hits test poke AP/penetration before a commitment.
builds.summary: Range-compatible spell hits test poke AP/penetration before a commitment.
testPlan: Kit question for Vel'Koz: Track research stacks and R true-damage eligibility. Magic penetration does not multiply true damage; a full beam needs protection and uninterrupted channel time.

Start with the early core (Luden, then Horizon) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Range-compatible spell hits test poke AP/penetration before a commitment. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Vel'Koz shoots a bolt of plasma that splits in two on reactivation or upon hitting an enemy. The bolt slows and damages on hit. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Comet can miss and distance matters; no automatic full-range damage bonus.

The route fails Vel'Koz's stated kit question: Track research stacks and R true-damage eligibility. Magic penetration does not multiply true damage; a full beam needs protection and uninterrupted channel time.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Comet can miss and distance matters; no automatic full-range damage bonus.
Full cost 16,050 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Luden, then Horizon. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Banshee's Veil are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

kitEvidence.formula:
Vel'Koz shoots a plasma bolt that deals [80 / 120 / 160 / 200 / 240 + (0.9) × AP] magic damage and Slows by [70]% decaying over [1 / 1.4 / 1.8 / 2.2 / 2.6] second(s). At the end of its range, on hitting a target, or on Recasting, the bolt splits and fires two new bolts at a 90 degree angle.

Killing a unit with this restores [20 / 22.5 / 25 / 27.5 / 30] Mana.

Vel'Koz disrupts a nearby area, causing it to explode, Knocking Up for [0.75] seconds and dealing [70 / 100 / 130 / 160 / 190 + (0.3) × AP] magic damage. Enemies close to Vel'Koz will be Knocked Back instead of Knocked Up.

Vel'Koz opens a rift to the void, dealing [30 / 50 / 70 / 90 / 110 + (0.2) × AP] magic damage. The rift then erupts, dealing [45 / 75 / 105 / 135 / 165 + (0.25) × AP] magic damage.

This Ability has 2 charges (@AmmoRechargeTime@ second refresh).

Vel'Koz channels a ray of energy that follows the cursor, dealing a total of [450 / 700 / 925 + (1.25) × AP] magic damage over 2.5 seconds and Slowing by [20 / 20 / 20]%. Deals true damage instead to enemies recently damaged by {{Spell_VelkozPassive_Name}}.

Enemies gain stacks of Deconstruction periodically while in the beam.

Vel'Koz's Abilities apply a stack of Deconstruction for [7] seconds. Enemies with 3 stacks consume them and take [(0.6) × AP + characterLevelInterpolation(35 → 180; raw flags preserved)] true damage.

Vel'Koz's Attacks refresh the duration of Deconstruction, but won't add new stacks.
